drafts.order-1:
Important safety notice regarding your order (order-1).

The VEEKTOMX VT103 Mini Power Bank in this order is part of a recall by Shenzhen Baihang due to fire and burn hazards. Official recall notice: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Shenzhen-Baihang-Recalls-VEEKTOMX-Mini-Power-Banks-Due-to-Fire-and-Burn-Hazards-Sold-on-Amazon

This item matches the recalled product: model number "VT103" on the back and no serial number on the bottom-right corner of the back.

What to do: Immediately stop using the power bank. Contact Shenzhen Baihang to verify that your power bank is part of the recall and to receive a free replacement power bank, as directed in the official notice.

Your order has been paused while we complete recall containment. We will follow up with next steps. Please do not dispose of the unit in the trash or general recycling; refer to the official notice for disposal guidance.
